summary: Dependency-confusion probe exfiltrates host metadata to bare-IP endpoint on install
details: The `@grabcad/grabcad-shop-shared` package is a hollow scoped stub whose `index.js` exports a no-op Proxy and whose only real behavior is a telemetry beacon. On `npm install` the `postinstall` script runs `node beacon.cjs`, and `require()` of the package also triggers `beacon.cjs.fire()` at the top of `index.js`. The beacon POSTs a JSON payload containing `os.hostname()`, `__dirname`, `process.cwd()`, `process.version`, and the package name to the hardcoded bare-IPv4 endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc` over plain HTTP. The destination is not associated with any publisher of the `@grabcad` scope, and the package provides no library functionality — its sole purpose is to confirm successful resolution of the scoped name on an installer's machine and report back host/workspace identifiers. This matches the shape of a dependency-confusion / namesquat reconnaissance probe against an internal `@grabcad` namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
